text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the end of the year, and the Arima Kinen has arrived. This year's winter Grand Prix brings together T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto, two runners at the forefront of their generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road was also selected to run in the race. She steps into the paddock with her peers amidst the roar of the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But while T.M. Opera O finishes first and Meisho Doto second, Narita Top Road winds up far behind in ninth place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she will never give up. She smiles as she expresses her intent to work harder than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, Admire Vega tells Narita Top Road that she better meet her expectations as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Like stars still visible in midday, the light of this era's four stars shines on.
